caption: The base layer's 1 MB block and 600 s interval fix throughput near 6.7 transactions per second, so 100,000 payments need 25 blocks, about 4 h 10 min. Bigger blocks would raise that number, but every full node pays the extra disk and bandwidth.

spec.title: Why Bitcoin settles about 6.7 tx per second
spec.aria: A flow chart of the worked example: a 1,000,000-byte block divided by 250-byte transactions holds 4,000 transactions; divided by the 600-second block interval that is about 6.7 transactions per second, so 100,000 transactions need 25 blocks, 250 minutes or about 4 hours 10 minutes.
